notes.title: Orebody: Binder's Tale, a new run and gun 8bit NES shooter, releases on Steam!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Vn5drMAeu2I;full][/previewyoutube]

Nami Tentou releases [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2124210/Orebody_Binders_Tale/]Orebody: Binder's Tale on Steam[/url] as of November 30th!

If you're a fan of Contra and Mega-man, this is a game you can't miss!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9691265/c6723a77d69e8b4dd05b0695327bbb92bf155a9d.gif[/img]

"Orebody: Binder’s Tale is a run and gun shooter that takes place on the alien world of Orebody. Built using the constraints of classic 8-bit games, Binder’s Tale provides an authentic old school experience for young and old players alike. As an orphaned battle bot named Binder, players run, jump, and blast their way across Orebody in order to reach the Floating City of Galvanstad, a hovering A.I. fortress, to confront their makers and avenge the death of their mentor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9691265/cc3f403bcfb7d18888a3ca6d10402325e2310649.gif[/img]

But that’s not all! The Steam version of Binder’s Tale contains a bonus 8-bit game experience, Orebody: Sand Ripples. In this short box-pushing puzzle game, players control a sand squid that is trying to save the Great Sand Sea Solorus from the destructive mining practices of the SolarSeed corporation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9691265/757926b6d08fda360a6a1f3263e791cf4480720d.gif[/img]

With the Steam version of Binder’s Tale, you get it all! Play through the game’s campaign in Novice or Advanced difficulty modes. Try to beat every one of the game’s bosses in a row using only three lives in Boss Rush mode, or simply sit back and jam out to the game’s soundtrack in Jukebox mode."

[b]Now with a launch discount of 10% off! Pick it up now for the holidays! :)[/b]

Click [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2124210/Orebody_Binders_Tale/]here[/url] to buy the game.

notes.title: PING REDUX v1.01 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

We've appreciated all the feedback that you've sent in. We've patched up some problem areas with bosses with the info and fixed some levels. :)

- Changed delete save data text to be less ambiguous
- Changed how the bullets interact with the player so that you aren't shoved out
- Added a new visual option to toggle in options

We are always happy to hear from our players so feel free to reach out to us in any way possible! We'll do our best to respond.

We are looking at doing more levels, but of course we want to base whatever level update we do on a unified theme, so we are looking for any suggestions from you! Let us know in the comments!
